rule: a paragraph breaks at a blank line or \par AT PROSE LEVEL. A display environment is SPANNED, not a break. List environments are skipped entirely (--par-lists False). Front matter macros are dropped and counted separately.
corrected: 2026-10-02: `\end {pmatrix}` with a space was not recognised, and a DEPTH COUNTER never recovers from one missed close -- sigma26-077 reached 27.1% of its body and reported 30 paragraphs instead of 107. The walk now keeps a stack and pops by name, and reports its own coverage. Found by pdfdrill's cross-check.
